title: Enterprise Navigation Optimization

architecture.before: Every sidebar click = full document navigation. SW soft-online network-first (TTFB ~400ms). HTML re-downloaded; JS re-executed; shell rebuilt.
architecture.after: Same ERP shell kept alive. Content-swap replaces #rateb-main-content only. Cache API first for HTML; SW SWR for full document navigations; hover/idle prefetch; module lifecycle; POS fetch dedupe + slower probes; Server-Timing headers.

optimizations_shipped: 2 SW navigate SWR + client Cache API first for content-swap
5 Content-swap same tenant/session/shell; history pushState; refresh still full load
7 Common libs not reloaded; module scripts idle after cache hit
8 Offline reuses Cache API HTML + existing IDB/SW (no recreate)
9 POS fetch dedupe + probe 45s/8s; metrics idle; connectivity 8s
expected_gain: Online warm nav ~430ms TTFB → ~18ms swap (~95%+). Offline module open ~1000ms usable wait → ~14ms swap when cached.
constraints_honored: No PHP business logic / schema / RBAC / API changes
